title: Tracking the 5,000-kilometre journey between democracy and authoritarianism
html:
Editor's note: An earlier version of the story incorrectly stated that Nikita Khrushchev banged his shoe on a table at the United Nations and shouted “We will crush you!” at the height of the 1956 Cuban Missile Crisis. Those incidents happened before the Cuban Missile Crisis which was in 1962. This version has been corrected.

* Reporting and writing by __Mark MacKinnon__ * Photography and video by __Melissa Tait__, __Anna Liminowicz__ and __Olga Ivashchenko__ * Field producing by __Yulia Ochetova__ * Interactive design, development and graphics by __Jeremy Agius__ * Photo editing by __Solana Cain__ * Video editing by __Melissa Tait__ and __Kelsey Wilson__ * Story editing by __Marie-Danielle Smith__, __Mason Wright__ and __Liann Bobechko__ * __Hamida Ghafour__, Deputy Foreign Editor * __Danielle Webb__, Deputy Visuals Editor, Data and Digital Storytelling
summary: A road trip along the frontier between democracy and authoritarianism took us from a nuclear bunker in Finland to a dying city in Ukraine
